title: Audio Compatibility Downmix Normalization
problem: Playback planning can select audio streams and HLS renditions, but it does not yet model client channel support, downmix, dynamic range, or normalization as explicit requirements.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-transcode hls audio --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened the audio compatibility lane, linked it from playback architecture indexes, and split playback requirement modeling before transcode propagation and FFmpeg filter planning.
Added playback-owned audio output requirement values, downmix and normalization intent, audio compatibility reasons, and tests proving channel-limited playback selects transcode instead of remux.

Propagated playback-owned audio output requirements through transcode execution policy, pipeline planning, profile identity, and server HLS adaptation; stabilized the concurrent HLS playlist gate without changing runtime semantics.

Added deterministic FFmpeg HLS audio filter planning for downmix, normalization, combined downmix plus normalization, and audio sidecar outputs without adding UI preference storage, HDR tone mapping, subtitle burn-in, web player, or public DTO changes.

continue_policy.notes: ACDN-040 is accepted on main. Next task is ACDN-050 for final evidence consolidation, architecture map updates, and closeout. Split HDR, subtitle burn-in, persisted user preferences, device profile databases, and web player controls into separate workstreams.
